hero.caption: An U.S. Marine Corps McDonnell RF-4B-24-MC Phantom II aircraft (BuNo 153094) on the flight line of Marine Corps Air Station El Toro, California (USA), on 4 April 1978. The aircraft was assigned to Marine photo reconnaissance squadron VMFP-3 Eyes of the Corps and was finally retired to the AMARC as 8F0335 on 19 July 1989.
